item.title: Graph Anomaly Detection as Finite-Horizon Control
item.description: EB-GAD scores graph anomalies with no labels and no training: empirical Bayes fits a graph-aware Gaussian model of normal in closed form, and each node is scored by the finite-horizon control energy needed to steer a neutral start to it under a graph Ornstein–Uhlenbeck process. Best or tied-best AUROC on 9 of 11 benchmarks.
